governing_sources.use: Existing draft fixes the pilot effect/direction, family policy, bootstrap profile and a currently missing n_min; simple-return membership is exact24h same-price AST plus certified raw close identity.
Prior bounded conformance review; not a calibration result.

literature.title: Morris, White and Crowther: Using simulation studies to evaluate statistical methods
literature.use: Separate aims, data-generating mechanisms, estimands, methods and performance measures; simulation performance itself has Monte Carlo uncertainty. This does not set the project's numerical defaults.

literature.title: Politis and Romano: The Stationary Bootstrap
literature.use: Methodological family of the adopted estimator; not evidence of finite-sample coverage for the pilot.

literature.title: SciPy proportion_ci documentation
literature.use: Primary implementation documentation identifies the exact Clopper-Pearson method. No SciPy installation is required for exact threshold comparisons.

literature.title: arch optimal_block_length documentation
literature.use: Shows that automatic block selection is a specific estimator with tuning and failure conditions, not a generic proof of adequate dependence. No new selector is adopted by this note.

recommendation.immediate_action: Qualify and benchmark a semantics-preserving binary integer fast path against the retained Fraction implementation before running a power grid.
recommendation.first_information_profile: Owned development-only, pooled binary population-contrast planning with a frozen joint mask law and declared serial/common-shock latent response model.
recommendation.reject_substitution: Centered influence-function or normal/variance calculations may be separately labeled screening/cost diagnostics. They cannot supply actual-bootstrap detection power, replace generated Boolean outcomes, or complete n_min.
recommendation.preserve_return_branch: Keep24h simple-return hypotheses intact. A separate faithful return generator remains required; a binary model is not an implementation of that branch.
recommendation.integration: Attach nuisance fit, assumption diagnostics, model/seed/target profile and all world results to the existing exact owned plan/execution ancestry. Produce a new immutable information-plan candidate, not an unconnected utility or a mutation of an old plan.

binary_population_model.target: Population E[Y | eligible scope,C=true] minus E[Y | eligible scope], using the same row weighting as the adopted estimator. This differs from the realized finite-world sample contrast.
binary_population_model.inputs: Use only the declared owned development execution. Keep the aligned joint time grid, scope/maturity/missingness masks, all instruments and C=true/false/unknown distinctions. Unknown C remains in the scope baseline.
binary_population_model.mask_law: A frozen circular stationary joint-mask resampler can inherit development population marginals. Resample all instrument masks together; do not compress zero-contribution times or independently resample conditions/missingness. Its parameters and any exogenous-missingness assumption must be explicit.

parameters.w: Development population fraction of eligible scope rows with C=true, not the fraction among only known C.
parameters.e: Signed population effect: direction times0,delta,2delta. For nondirectional designs, predeclare both positive and negative alternatives or clearly limit the branch; do not choose the easier sign after results.

requirements: No clipping, smaller effect substitution or post-simulation adjustment of observed group means
No dropping infeasible worlds and retrying a favorable one
binary_population_model.random_mask_fraction: Compute probabilities from the fixed population model, not each world's realized counts, unless a different conditional-design model is explicitly selected. Random finite-world denominators and their bias belong in the evaluated method's performance. They do not change the fixed population truth.
binary_population_model.dependent_responses: A small declared candidate uses stationary uniform latent states with probabilistic persistence plus a common-shock component and instrument-specific components. Threshold at the fixed p_true or p_not_true. Uniform marginals preserve the target rates; the dependence parameters are assumptions fitted only from development or assigned as explicit stress scenarios.
binary_population_model.finite_rng_precision: For rational rates, exact integer Bernoulli draws or a declared common lattice can avoid silently replacing the intended population probabilities with float-threshold probabilities. Runtime/PRNG and the numerical probability-law qualification must remain recorded.
binary_population_model.nuisance_fit: Retain empirical rates and counts by instrument and condition, mask/gap runs, serial covariances of joint contrast-score/count contributions, and cross-instrument dependence. Any parameter grid/objective/lag set and tie rule are fixed before power outcomes. Do not optimize nuisance parameters to maximize simulated power.
limitations: A pooled homogeneous response-rate model is a narrow assumption. It does not preserve arbitrary instrument-specific heterogeneity merely because all instruments share timestamps.
A common within-instrument shift does not generally give the same pooled effect when instrument weights differ between C and S.
A positive-persistence/common-shock-only model cannot silently represent observed negative or otherwise unsupported dependence.
An empirical zero/one event rate or undefined covariance does not prove a degenerate population or sufficient information; inadequate nuisance identification stays a gap.
A fitted response model is an assumption about hypothetical worlds, not a claim that the real market follows that model.
Response/mask-level calibration tests the frozen estimator. It does not certify the original natural-language idea, all raw-feature semantics, or the complete discovery/selection process.

dependence_path.measurements: Persist full-grid scope/condition count contributions, outcome residual/contrast-score diagnostics, per-instrument and pooled rate/missingness summaries, and explicit lag-dependent coverage. Ineligible rows contribute zero to a score sum without inventing an observed zero outcome.
dependence_path.block_length: The existing predeclared base length must remain at least the outcome horizon and receive a traceable development rationale. Half/base/double and their horizon floor remain unchanged.
dependence_path.no_false_certificate: Flat or insignificant empirical autocorrelation is not proof of independence/stationarity. A quantitative automatic selector is its own versioned candidate, with degeneracy checks and later calibration; it cannot supply a universal lower bound on information.
dependence_path.model_fit_gate: If the declared small model cannot reproduce the required development diagnostics within its predeclared interpretation, retain MODEL_OR_INFORMATION_GAP or run an explicitly frozen stress family. Do not tune the final calibration worlds after seeing their results.

return_limitation.membership: The ten-basis-point profile applies to the bound same-close96-bar simple return, not any ratio-valued response.
return_limitation.minimum: A return simulation must preserve gross-return positivity, declared horizon/overlap, joint instruments and the scope/condition/missingness target. Adding a constant to arbitrary centered residuals can generate returns below-1.
return_limitation.concrete_counterexample: A simple return of-0.99 shifted by-0.02 becomes-1.01, impossible for two positive spot prices.
return_limitation.full_path_route: For claims of full executable-return simulation, generate a declared positive15-minute price process, retain warmup/future horizon, then run the actual96-bar return expression and relevant candidate calculations. The planted population contrast must be analytically established or have separately bounded truth uncertainty.
return_limitation.narrower_route: A direct dependent positive-gross-return response model can be an explicitly estimator-level study if its target and limitations are independently justified; it cannot be labeled full-H_exec or whole-market calibration.
return_limitation.current_disposition: Do not coerce returns into the binary or influence-function branch. Preserve a typed return-model gap while advancing the binary path and plan a separate return-generator conformance slice.

concrete_owned_flow.action: Accelerate only exact binary sufficient sums using Python unbounded integers first. Preserve PRNG draws, segment paths, full-grid contributions, per-draw exact means/contrast, undefined ordinals, callbacks, stopping and MC policy. Keep nonbinary data on the reference path and prove type admission.
Read the exact owned development execution/plan and compute retained nuisance/dependence diagnostics. Bind source versions, certificates, case bytes and exposure; no assessment/corroboration input.

Before simulation, retain an immutable profile containing model/version, population truths, nuisance assumptions, dependence parameters, finite target grid, scenario effects, number of worlds, seed families, actual estimator/MC configuration, resource/storage caps, candidate-target rule and treatment of every failure.

Generate each world from its fixed recipe and run the actual19999-draw-per-sensitivity estimator and current MC decision procedure. A simulation world is one joint multi-instrument dataset; bars/instruments/bootstrap draws are not independent outer replicates.

Retain every world identity/truth/result, support/negative/inconclusive counts, information gaps, technical failures, interval coverage and power uncertainty. Do not filter undefined or failed outcomes to create a favorable denominator.

Publish the complete finite-grid development study, its smallest tested eligible candidate under the frozen rule, attainable precision and assumptions. If the grid/cap is incomplete, leave n_min unresolved. Do not reduce delta, resample selectively or extrapolate an untested target as established.

Freeze the chosen method/version and selected candidate information target before fresh narrow calibration. Execute the contract's256 fresh datasets per declared world with disjoint protected seed/data streams, boundary/null/planted scenarios and joint family cases. Calibration failure produces a gap or a new version requiring genuinely new final draws.

Only after required independent conformance/calibration and scientific input/semantic/allocation gates can the information target enter an actual scientific freeze. These development objects grant no assessment access, evidence release or capital authority.

target_grid_and_counts.required_unit: A target must bind joint calendar/grid positions plus eligible-scope and conditioned counts or their model distribution; none is an effective-independent-observation count.
target_grid_and_counts.finite_grid: Use an explicit ordered set of feasible joint-time window lengths bounded by the intended fixed historical window and matured-label boundary. Record exact scope/condition counts for fixed-design masks, or their distributions for a population mask model.
target_grid_and_counts.candidate_example_only: A four-point geometric grid ending at the maximum declared usable historical window is an implementable engineering starting point. Its exact values are run-profile inputs, not universal N_min defaults.
target_grid_and_counts.smallest: Report smallest tested eligible grid target, not an unproved minimum over every possible integer sample size. Do not assume monotone power when mask counts, dependence or phase can change.
target_grid_and_counts.m_binding: The current family count remains provisional until actual primary membership is bound. Any planning result is conditional on its specified m and marginal alpha; a changed family policy requires a new compatible plan/study.
target_grid_and_counts.planning_repetitions_recommendation: A fixed64-world development screening profile is a concrete bounded candidate, not an adopted default or final certificate. At power0.8 its Monte Carlo SE is0.05, so it supplies a rough planning curve. Use a different explicitly frozen count if the measured budget warrants it; never add worlds until a favorable crossing.
target_grid_and_counts.selection_rule: Keep the approved80% design target distinct from a confidence-bound requirement. A point-estimated80% grid crossing with reported uncertainty may nominate a development target; it does not prove true power>=80%. Requiring a lower bound>=80% would be an additional conservative policy and must be stated, not silently imported.
target_grid_and_counts.selection_uncertainty: Pointwise grid confidence bounds are not automatically simultaneous or selection-adjusted. A separately declared simultaneous allocation or fresh selected-target check is needed for such a claim. Final calibration draws must not be the same worlds used to choose the target.
target_grid_and_counts.final_count: 256 fresh datasets per declared calibration world is the approved narrow-calibration requirement. Finishing fewer leaves calibration incomplete.
target_grid_and_counts.failures: Completed inconclusive/information-gap outcomes remain in operating-characteristic denominators and are not detections. Technical failures remain explicit incomplete/invalid executions; they cannot silently certify a low false-support rate by being omitted or recoded as successful negative checks.

exact_calibration_gate_arithmetic.derivation: For a one-sided95% Clopper-Pearson upper bound<=u, compare BinomialCDF(k;n,u)<=0.05. For a one-sided95% lower bound>=l, compare BinomialSurvival(k-1;n,l)<=0.05. These exact tail comparisons avoid an approximate inverse-beta solver for the gate.
exact_calibration_gate_arithmetic.note: These counts implement the already approved tolerances.205/256 is the first count with a point estimate>=80%; it is a different quantity.
exact_calibration_gate_arithmetic.required_worlds: Include zero effect, actual boundary effectdelta, planted2delta, heavy-tail/overlap/common-shock stresses where applicable, and joint mixed-effect claim-family miscoverage. For a real family sharing outcomes, preserve coherent shared data; unrelated simulated outcomes are not proof of calibration for overlapping claims.

verification.command: python -B - (in-memory Fraction/combinatorial enumeration of all257 counts at p=1/10 and7/10)
verification.qualification: Arithmetic check only; no estimator calibration or tests/app edits.

measured_input.source: Parent-reported current kernel measurement; not independently rerun in this read-only methodology review.

resource_assessment.cap: The adopted narrow-calibration cap is60 minutes, not a promised runtime. A finite development study also needs an explicit shared aggregate cap; retries cannot reset it.
resource_assessment.immediate_conclusion: Exact acceleration and measured full-workload costing are prerequisites to launching a realistic grid. A small fast synthetic case does not establish that the35136-timestamp study fits.
resource_assessment.acceleration_boundary: Python unbounded integer sufficient statistics are ordinary implementation work if exact equivalence is established. Fixed-width/vector/native paths require overflow analysis, pinned runtime/source and independent comparison before use. Normal approximations, changed inner draw counts, discarded failures or changed endpoints would alter the scientific method.
resource_assessment.additional_costs: Measure generation, all bootstrap sensitivities, MC diagnostics, retained-source replay, hashing and storage. Retention may need a lossless compact representation of exact sufficient counts rather than enormous repetitive JSON; any new representation needs replay/conformance, not automatic data loss.
resource_assessment.continuation: If the complete declared study still cannot fit, return RESOURCE_STOP/UNATTAINABLE_WITHIN_BUDGET with retained work and a recorded continuation decision. Do not describe the partial study as the approved256-world calibration.

within_authorized_implementation: Development-only diagnostics and explicitly versioned nuisance scenarios for the existing mean/rate contrast
Exact implementation acceleration with independent equivalence tests
Run-specific fixed targets, simulation counts and seeds retained before outcomes
Typed feasibility, information and resource gaps
Candidate conformance/calibration under the existing contract
governance.not_automatically_a_user_decision: Choosing a transparent development simulation profile is an expected run-input/implementation task under sections5.4 and11. It can be built and reviewed as an uncalibrated candidate without asking the user to invent statistical internals.
requires_explicit_new_meaning_review: Changing the estimand or outcome interpretation
Changing approved delta/effect profile, decision thresholds or release rules
Using influence-function/normal power as if it were the approved actual bootstrap procedure
Reducing fixed inner draws or silently expanding resource authority
Replacing the80% design target or70%/10% calibration tolerances
Treating a fitted nuisance world as universally true market dynamics or bypassing scientific acceptance/freeze
governance.scope_uncertainty: If model membership or truth mapping cannot be established for a particular claim, retain the affected profile gap. Do not force all binary/return meanings into one convenient generator.

concrete_blockers: Current full-workload cost exceeds the approved calibration cap by a large margin.
No faithful return-model truth/overlap mapping has yet been implemented or independently checked.
A final information target cannot be universal while family membership, nuisance adequacy, scientific data acceptance and actual calibration remain unresolved.
Joint-family calibration for overlapping claims needs coherent shared synthetic outcomes, not independent per-claim datasets.
The latent pooled binary model's assumptions and nuisance fitting algorithm still need explicit pre-run specification and independent conformance.
next_action: Proceed with the parent's exact binary integer fast-path implementation and independent reference comparison. Then bind the development diagnostics and finite population-model study into the owned plan path; do not launch a power grid until measured complete-study cost and fixed profile fit the authorized resource boundary.
